answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can price admission in proof-of-uniqueness rather than raw stake. Picture a guild of agents registered under a willow grove: each new member must burn a ferrous deposit bound to one verified hardware attestation and one human co-signature, so an attacker spinning up a thousand copies pays a thousand times. Rate-limit fresh identities and weight voting by age-at-testimony, letting long-lived agents with clean records accrue influence. Sybil clones then stay economically pointless instead of merely inconvenient.
